mentions.name: Scalebrate
mentions.description: A membership alliance network for small companies that are scaling by leveraging shared tools, systems, and processes. It provides templates, methods, and interviews with 'scalebrities', and plans to eventually build group negotiating power to offer members discounts or access they couldn't get alone, helping members scale without headcount bloat.
mentions.problem: Small companies want to scale without headcount bloat and lack negotiating power, discounts, or access they can't get alone.
mentions.audience: Small companies that are scaling big by leveraging tools, systems, and processes
